svg.title: L1 Engine - pin ladder
svg.text: One block per housing, one row per cavity. Every wire runs straight from its cavity to where it lands. Read left to right.
L1-E1 · HDP26-24-29SE / HDP24-24-29PE · mixed-contact circular · PMU box
Splice at the coil bracket → BW of coil T, coil L, igniter T, igniter L
reserved - no wire in the leg
O13 pinned to the receptacle in the PMU box (12 AWG from pin); the L1 plug carries a size-12 sealing
plug — the swap's rebuilt leg pins it (D-271)
reserved - no wire in the leg
O14 pinned to the receptacle in the PMU box (12 AWG from pin); size-12 sealing plug in the L1 plug
#12 A/C clutch feed (LS, LW32) - its source in the
box is settled at the CAD pass
reserved - no wire in the leg
K9 terminal 86, in the bay junction (D-609)
Sender C-09, spade — factory wire BrY
Reservoir switch C-05: terminal BR; terminal B → block ground
Inhibitor A-06: 8.2 kΩ in the lead to terminal GY; terminal RW → block ground. The 47 kΩ baseline
from this lead to the block ground at the switch (D-487). D-610: the series resistor sits on the PMU
box's board at this wire's end, not in the harness; D-610: the 47 kΩ baseline stays at the far end,
potted into the switch's sealed pigtail, so a broken wire still reads as a fault
reserved - no wire in the leg
Wired across the PMU box to DP-ICU 15 (N67) — the ICU's spare input reaches the post; sealing plug
reserved - no wire in the leg
The spare block-B fuse position is wired to the receptacle cavity (N68), no fuse fitted; sealing plug in
Inhibitor A-06: 8.2 kΩ in the lead to terminal BY; terminal BW → block ground. The 47 kΩ baseline
from this lead to the block ground at the switch (D-487: it sat at the nose on the transit contact until
then, D-368 pattern). D-610: the series resistor sits on the PMU box's board at this wire's end, not in
the harness; D-610: the 47 kΩ baseline stays at the far end, potted into the switch's sealed pigtail, so
a broken wire still reads as a fault
Sender C-02, spade — factory wire YW
Coil T (B-18) negative terminal — factory wire YG. Shield grounded in the PMU box end only (N48,
N113): the engine end of the shield is cut back and insulated at the coil, and carried through L1-E1
No device: the tach cable's shield and drain, cut back and insulated at the coil (L1-E1 15), carried
through here to the PMU box's GND bus (N113, D-556). The shield is grounded at the node only.

Solid wire: live. Dashed: run and capped at the far end. A box on a wire is a resistor potted into the switch's pigtail (D-610); #12 / #16 / #20 is a circular's contact size. Generated by rx7.py diagrams - do not edit.
